thread:
Jordan: eu-west1 embeddings are returning 503s since 10:01 UTC. Alerting infra and ops. High customer impact for paid accounts. Can we fast-track a patch?
Sam: seeing it too, spike to ~30% error rate, traffic mostly hitting eu-west1.
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-147. CI pipeline triggered for branch hotfix/embeddings-503. Build queued.
deploy-bot: CI passed (unit + integration). Artifact: redwood-embed@sha256:abc123. Ready for canary.
Lee: what's the risk if we skip canary? any schema or model changes in this patch?
Jordan: no schema/model changes — just a retry loop fix + kv-cache race guard. Small binary patch, no DB migrations.
Priya: requesting expedited approval. SLA breach in progress for some customers. I'm +1 to skip canary if oncall watches the rollout and we have a rollback trigger. :thumbsup:
Sam: oncall here — I can monitor and execute rollback within 5m if errors spike.
Lee: ok. Tagging infra. Please pin the artifact and prepare deploy steps.
Jordan: Deploy command (will do canary by default):
```
deployctl deploy --service=embed-service --image=redwood-embed@sha256:abc123 --namespace=eu-west1 --canary-percent=5
```
Priya: approve expedited path. Set canary-percent=0 (skip) and enforce rollback if 5xx > 5% over 2m.
ops-rotation: Acknowledged. Increasing logging and tracing for embed-service in eu-west1. I'll watch traces and p95 latency dashboards.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by Jordan. Canary 0% (expedited approval). Start time 2026-03-20T10:05:00Z.
Jordan: kicking it off now.
Sam: new pods coming up, readiness checks passing.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to new pods. Metrics after 60s: 5xx errors dropped from 30% -> 1.2%.
Priya: good signal. Keep monitoring for 10m; if it stays low we can close incident.
Lee: add a follow-up to run a normal canary across other regions tomorrow and a post-deploy job to validate cold-start sequences.
Jordan: release-note snippet: "hotfix: embeddings 503 on short sequences in eu-west1 — fixed retry logic and kv-cache race; expedited rollout."
Sam: monitoring — will call rollback if >5% 5xx sustained for 2m.
deploy-bot: Patch marked deployed. Incident INC-2026-147 moved to monitoring phase. :white_check_mark:
Priya: thanks everyone. I'll draft the public release note and a short postmortem template.
ops-rotation: I'll keep an eye on logs for any anomalous spikes overnight.
Lee: closing this thread once postmortem and release note are linked.
Jordan: thanks — nice fast team response.
